In Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), a retriever first retrieves relevant text evidence D from a corpus C given a query q. The retrieved evidence is then used by a reader LLM to generate an answer
outputs: generated answers to the input queries
The reader LLM generates an answer based on the retrieved and selected evidence.
